title: Records, Printouts & Faults
whatItIs: Keep a full record of your working day. At the roadside, show records for today and the previous 28 days (56 for UK–EU journeys). Use printouts or manual entries when needed.

keyFacts.text: At the roadside you MUST produce records for today and the previous 28 days (56 for UK–EU journeys).

keyFacts: Keep a record of your whole working day, including work away from the vehicle.
Carry enough print roll for a printout if an officer asks.

keyFacts.text: With an analogue tachograph, you MUST return used charts to your operator within 42 days.

keyFacts: Operators download vehicle units at least every 90 days and driver cards at least every 28 days.

visual.caption: When you need a manual record or printout

rows: Manual entry on the tachograph or chart
Manual record on a chart or printout
Reasons on a printout, by the stopping place
Signed printout with the reason, asap
Start and end printouts (up to 15 days)
notes: Printouts need your name, card or licence number, and your signature.

a.label: Analogue chart
points: Wax-coated chart: no more than 24 hours on one chart
Centrefield: name, places, dates, odometer readings

b.label: Digital printout
points: Printed from the tachograph on type-approved print roll
Manual notes need your name, card or licence number, signature

onTheTest.question: On a UK-only journey, records for how many previous days must you show at a roadside check, as well as today?
onTheTest.why: Today and the previous 28 calendar days, or 56 days for journeys to and from an EU country.

onTheTest.question: Your driver card stops working during a trip. What must you do?
options: Stop until a new card arrives
Use printouts; report it to DVLA
onTheTest.why: You may drive for up to 15 days with start and end printouts. Report it to DVLA and apply for a new card within 7 days.

traps: UK–EU journeys: 56 days of records, not 28.
Diaries and timesheets aren't allowed as manual records.
A faulty tachograph must be repaired asap: en route if you can't get back to base within a week.
